elements.name: q_1
elements.title: Does a visible label alone provide a standardized input-purpose token?
choices: No, the label and machine-readable purpose have different roles
Yes, all labels are autocomplete tokens

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: Which field is within the criterion’s scope when the technology supports it?
choices: A field collecting the user’s email address

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: Why should an order number not use autocomplete="email"?
choices: The token misrepresents the information requested

answer_key.q_1: No, the label and machine-readable purpose have different roles
answer_key.q_2: A field collecting the user’s email address
answer_key.q_3: The token misrepresents the information requested

explanations.q_1: Labels communicate with users; appropriate autocomplete tokens expose standardized purposes.
explanations.q_2: The user’s email is a listed input purpose; evaluate all applicability conditions.
explanations.q_3: A token should accurately represent the field’s purpose.
